description: Ciclovia del Sole - percorso is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. La ciclovia del Sole è un percorso ciclabile in progetto che inizia a Capo Nord e termina a La Valletta. Attraversa ben otto nazioni: Norvegia, Finlandia, Svezia, Danimarca, Germania, Repubblica Ceca, Austria e Italia. La ciclovia pubblicata in questo dataset è una parte del tratto italiano inaugurato nel mese di aprile del 2021. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. Its keywords are Mobilità persone e merci, infrastrutture, Turismo di prossimità. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
